name: agent-interrogation
description: Adaptive requirements-interview skill for coding agents; clarify the task and agree on a specification before implementation.

interface.longDescription: A requirements-first interview for coding agents. Inspect relevant project context, identify blocking ambiguities, adapt interview depth (Auto, Light, Standard, Deep), resolve conflicting choices, and prepare an acceptance-testable specification before asking for explicit approval to implement. Useful for underspecified features and multi-module integrations. Opt-in only. This is an instruction-based skill, not a technical write lock, and it does not guarantee time or token savings.
defaultPrompt: Use interrogation mode to clarify this feature's requirements before writing code.
Run a deep requirements interview for this architecture change and draft an approved spec.
